Given Musk's historical reluctance to take SpaceX public and the scale implied by a $3T market cap, this remains a very low-probability outcome.

title: Will LeBron James buy the Seattle Seahawks?

forecast.rationale: There is no credible indication that the Seahawks are being sold imminently, and the Paul Allen estate has suggested any sale process could take many years. LeBron James has expressed interest in sports ownership, but primarily NBA ownership, and an NFL control purchase would require a multi-billion-dollar consortium and league approval before the 2026 deadline.

title: Will Bill Gates buy the Seattle Seahawks?

forecast.rationale: The Seahawks could plausibly be sold by the Paul Allen estate before the 2026 deadline, but there is no strong public indication that Bill Gates is pursuing NFL ownership. Gates has the financial capacity, yet his interests have historically centered on philanthropy and technology rather than buying major sports franchises, making him an unlikely specific buyer.
